As if without censorship the site must be the wild west. Sadly, this seems to be a growing trend, and I sure as hell don't like it.

Seeing as I'm having a difficult time coming up with a legitimate reason to be searching for revenge porn or for it to exist at all, aside from those that get off to revenge porn (at which point... sucks to be you guys I guess, I assume you have your inner demons. Maybe see if can build a porn company that works on short movies with willing participants in a safe manner to non-violently recreate some of these fantasies you're obviously having?), I can't see any problem with Google blocking it. Presently, virtually all use of the term will be for illegal and horrific reasons. Perhaps if in the future the trend changes, and somehow that becomes a legitimate term (for example, should the legitimate porn industry in this field suddenly take off), then as long as Google would be willing to unblock it, should this unlikely scenario arise, then I'm fine with this level of censorship from them.

There's other search engines after all. Duck Duck Go is getting pretty popular I hear. There's room for more than one search engine. Just... don't compete to destroy eachother is all.

I'm pretty sure revenge porn has nothing to do with violence, it's when you make a sex video with your sig other and then break up and post it online. It's arguably a violation of one party's privacy, though I interpret it as a foolish misapplication of agency, ie if you don't want your ex to post your sex video don't make a fucking sex video. But I'm a generally unsympathetic fellow when it comes to humans and the fucked up shit they do to each other.

Hidden camera videos seem to be a much greater violation of privacy and rights but somehow that doesn't seem to be at issue here.

Ah, I misunderstood with the violent part.

Regardless, it's still horrifically illegal in a variety of ways, and who's only purpose is to destroy another's life. I stand by the rest of my post.

Regarding the "just don't make a video", that's a pointless argument. Some people get off on it, just telling them not to is pointless. It's going to happen regardless of any hopes or dreams we have of them stopping. For things like that, I consider "just nobody ever do this" to be a dead argument. It does however require trust, and precautions. If someone breaches a trust like that in that manner, that's where it's all kinds of fucked up. Taking the most joyous moments of a person's life, and turning it into their worst nightmare.

Obviously people get off on it, that's why they do it, but they do it with no understanding of the repercussions, legal and social, and that's their own damned fault. As I said, I am unsympathetic to people that make foolish decisions because they are in a relationship and trust someone. It is people acting irresponsibly. Just because it's something you want to do and you get off on it is no reason to expect some sort of extralegal safety net to diminish the negative impact of your irresponsible behavior. Should I feel bad when people that are into sex outdoors get mauled by lions or bears or whatever, or when people shove chair legs and light bulbs up their ass, or die of autoerotic asphyxiation? You rolls the dice, you takes your chances. Am I saying it is irresponsible to trust another person? Yes.

There are laws for this kind of thing, and I don't advocate any illegal activity, but neither do I advocate for extralegal protections. To put it plainly, I neither trust nor desire megacorporations to take upon themselves the role of interpreting law. I know that happens every day, I'm just saying I don't like it or trust it.

Anyway, the entire topic is moot for a number of reasons. The videos can and will be uploaded to places like Xhamster or Xvideos or Pornhub, only a total Internet novice would do a search for something illegal (like child pornography) or potentially illegal (like revenge porn) in Google. So really this will accomplish nearly nothing and simply serve as PR bullshit. Sure, websites that advertise HEY WE ARE THE REVENGE PORN PLACE TO GO TO! will have reduced hits but there is a whole seedy underbelly to the internet that will support them.
